The original conversation, composer, sid"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"ebar, and details surfaces remain mounted and usable."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"The `Room` tab is a complete native conversation workspace, not a standalone dashboard. It combines "},{"id":"p15s2","text":"Room selection, a chronological conversation and activity timeline, a recipient-aware composer, memb"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"er status and navigation, Session/provider attachment, removal, and close controls. Choose **Everyon"},{"id":"p15s4","text":"e** to broadcast or one member for a direct relay; accepted broadcasts share one relay identity and "},{"id":"p15s5","text":"appear once, while each member's visible-text reply appears under that Room timeline."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"### How the conversation timeline works"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Room does not create a second transcript database. Each successful built-in DSH delivery writes a du"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"rable `agent-team-room` source into the destination member Session with the Room id, stable member i"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"d, relay id, and direct/broadcast mode. Room stores the matching non-secret DSH Session MessageId as"},{"id":"p17s4","text":" an accepted receipt; the read-only Host projection requires an exact receipt, source, member, sende"},{"id":"p17s5","text":"r, mode, and MessageId match before rendering anything. It then keeps only visible-text assistant me"},{"id":"p17s6","text":"ssages from those turns, deduplicates a broadcast across recipients, and merges the result with meta"},{"id":"p17s7","text":"data-only activity rows. `rooms.json` never receives the prompt, reply body, or an external provider"},{"id":"p17s8","text":"'s opaque delivery id. Each selected-Room snapshot is bounded to the newest 200 conversation message"},{"id":"p17s9","text":"s, 200 activity rows, 20,000 characters per message, and 200,000 message characters total."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"The projection is deliberately fail-closed. If one child turn consumes a correlated Room relay plus "},{"id":"p18s2","text":"any other appended Session input—another Room, a human prompt, a notice, a goal/skill invocation, a "},{"id":"p18s3","text":"reference, or another plugin source—its assistant reply remains only in the backing Session instead "},{"id":"p18s4","text":"of being exposed in the Room timeline. The UI reports the hidden mixed-input reply and lets the user"},{"id":"p18s5","text":" open that Session. Replacement surface copies, reasoning blocks, tool calls, raw event payloads, pr"},{"id":"p18s6","text":"ovider addresses, profile digests, and unrelated Session turns are not projected."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"### Mention a Room member"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"Requirements: Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24` and DeepSeek Harness `0.1.0-rc.6`."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## Security boundaries"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"- Only the leader Session can mutate its Room. Native UI controls do not bypass Host checks.
- The b"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"uilt-in provider accepts only continuable direct-child Sessions and uses DSH's normal follow-up and "},{"id":"p27s3","text":"interruption paths.
- Message bodies go to the destination Session and are not copied into `rooms.js"},{"id":"p27s4","text":"on`; Room events retain delivery status and relay correlation only. External provider delivery ids a"},{"id":"p27s5","text":"re not persisted.
- The native read projection derives Room-addressed text from backing Session logs"},{"id":"p27s6","text":" on demand. It excludes replacement surface copies, reasoning, tool calls, unrelated turns, and any "},{"id":"p27s7","text":"reply from a turn that also consumed any other appended Session input.
- External providers without "},{"id":"p27s8","text":"the built-in DSH transcript protocol are shown as transcript unavailable; this never blocks delivery"},{"id":"p27s9","text":" or fabricates a Room reply.
- Member identity, including RoleHub provenance, is descriptive and nev"},{"id":"p27s10","text":"er a permission grant.
- The native snapshot endpoint returns derived Room message text. Its same-or"},{"id":"p27s11","text":"igin browser check is not authentication or tenant isolation: keep the Host private, or protect the "},{"id":"p27s12","text":"entire DSH origin with authenticated TLS and per-user access before remote use. Never publish an una"},{"id":"p27s13","text":"uthenticated tunnel directly.
- A provider is trusted same-process code. Room cannot sandbox a malic"},{"id":"p27s14","text":"ious or misconfigured provider.
- Do not put credentials or secrets in Room names, topics, summaries"},{"id":"p27s15","text":", member labels, or delivery content."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"See SECURITY.md for the complete deployment and migration boundaries."}],"truncated":true}
